sens_en: to consume, to use up, to waste
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : 耒, la charrue, et 毛, le poil. À force de labourer, la charrue s'use jusqu'à ne plus valoir un poil : user, consommer. 毛 se lit máo : il garde la rime de hào, pas son son.
origine_en: To remember it: 耒, the plough, and 毛, a hair. Ploughing wears the plough down until it is not worth a hair: to use up, to consume. 毛 is read máo: it shares the rhyme of hào, not its sound.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē hào yóu hěn duō.
phrase.en: This car uses a lot of fuel.
